Priya K.: Quick tracker for KiteLabs postmortem follow-ups: list and owners.
Sam H.: please list, I can own network pieces.
Priya K.: Problems: 1) VPC peering route propagation sometimes stale after recon. 2) On-prem NAT/firewall timeouts causing session drops. 3) Autoscale race binds old route table briefly. 4) No automated verification after peering change.
Linh: For (1) add retry with backoff in peering job + post-apply verification.
Marc: For (2) we need a minimal on-prem firewall/NAT expectation doc and Support test script.
Priya K.: Proposed owners: Peering retry: Sam H.; Verify job & alerts: Linh; On-prem runbook: Marc + Ops-Jen; Autoscale route triage: Priya.
Sam H.: I'll open RI-PEER-RETRY, plan RFC + prototype (ETA 2 wks).
Linh: I'll start a verification job behind a flag and add alert `peer.propagation.failures > 1` in 15m.
Ops-Jen: I'll coordinate Solutions for runbook; will capture TCP idle timeout, conntrack sizes, asymmetric routing notes.
Priya K.: SLAs: proposal 2w, impl 4-6w, canary 1 sprint. If any ticket needs >8w escalate.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-12-KiteLabs marked RESOLVED.
Sam H.: RI-PEER-RETRY-1400 created.
Linh: RI-PEER-VERIFY-4410 created, PR pending.
Marc: RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK-8801 created, working session scheduled.
Priya K.: RI-AUTOSCALE-ROUTE-6612 created, triage started. Ops please run Support test on KiteLabs staging once verify job is live. I'll schedule quarterly isolation trends review.
Sam H.: ack.
Linh: will ping on PR.
Marc: runbook draft uploaded to Confluence.
Priya K.: closing tracker once tickets show progress. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
